title: ModuleResourceService
responsibility: Generate declared module resources through templates, standard scaffolds or pinned package plans and persist their records.

inputs.name: ModuleResourceService.generate.root
inputs.description: Absolute project directory containing the package manifest and module metadata.

inputs.name: ModuleResourceService.generate.module
inputs.description: Identity of the installed module that owns this resource type.

inputs.name: ModuleResourceService.generate.type
inputs.description: Resource type declared by the installed module.

inputs.name: ModuleResourceService.generate.requested
inputs.description: Resource name, or a name with its responsibility group; dependency resources require an exact package pin.

outputs.name: ModuleResourceService.generate
outputs.description: Relative paths actually created or updated by this operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid definitions, incompatible project settings, unsafe paths or conflicting source files prevent the operation.
